articles.summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (NYSE: XRN) (the “Company” or “Chiron”) announced today the appointment of Philip L. Hawkins to its Board of Directors (the “Board”), effective immediately. Mr. Hawkins will serve as a member of the Board’s Audit and Compensation Committees. Mr. Hawkins brings more than 40 years of experience in real estate investment, operations, and capital allocation, including leadership roles at several of the industry’s most successful public and private real estate companies. Mr. Hawkins previously served as Executive Chairman of Link Logistics Real Estate, Blackstone’s U.S. industrial real estate platform. Prior to that, he served as President and Chief Executive Officer of DCT Industrial Trust, which he led from its 2006 IPO, with an equity market capitalization of approximately $2.1 billion, through its 2018 sale to Prologis in an $8.4 billion transaction. articles.summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (NYSE: XRN) (the “Company” or “Chiron”), today announced financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and other data. Mark Decker, Jr., Chief Executive Officer and President stated, “We continue to make meaningful progress executing our strategy, including our efforts to monetize the outpatient medical portfolio. We are encouraged by the strength of the market for high-quality medical office assets and the level of investor interest we have seen. At the same time, we continue to expand our seniors housing platform and are building a growing pipeline of attractive investment opportunities that we believe can position Chiron to thoughtfully redeploy capital and drive long-term growth.” NOTE: All share and per share data have been adjusted for all periods presented to reflect the Company’s one-for-five reverse stock split that was effective September 19, 2025.
